frozen_model.absolute_magnitude_convention: ^0.1 M_r - 5 log10(h); AB, hodpy SDSS/GAMA r band
frozen_model.mass_definition: M_PIN = PINOCCHIO fragmentation-group particle count times particle mass; not spherical overdensity

native_input.mass_definition: M_PIN = PINOCCHIO fragmentation-group particle count times particle mass; not spherical overdensity
native_input.occurrence_id_definition: (source part index << 48) + zero-based native row index
native_input.position_unit: comoving Mpc/h, observer-relative simulation Cartesian basis
native_input.velocity_unit: proper peculiar km/s, simulation Cartesian basis

frozen_model.occupation_sampling: Independent central Bernoulli and satellite Poisson, as hodpy; unobserved centrals may be fainter than the underlying cut
frozen_model.position_units: observer-relative comoving Mpc/h; native simulation Cartesian basis
frozen_model.selection: Underlying bright absolute-magnitude sample; selected_r_limit is applied only after painting. Not a complete faint flux-limited survey.
frozen_model.sky_coordinates: cone-aligned longitude/latitude in degrees; not ICRS
frozen_model.velocity_units: proper peculiar km/s; native simulation Cartesian basis

integrity.distance_units: Mpc/h comoving; sigma_v uses physical radius R_com/(1+z)
